statement.document_title: Hype, Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, the podcasters who love him — and how the New York Times’ commentary on AI has degenerated into industry cheerleading

our_interpretation: The claim concerns a change already made by March 14, 2025, rather than whether either forecast subsequently succeeded.
A postponement requires forecasts about substantially comparable capabilities.
Mostly means the predominant timeline in relevant public statements, not the existence of one later-dated statement.
Quietly means without clearly acknowledging a revision; it does not establish deliberate deception.
The target period spans the August 2023 baseline identified in the context and statements available by the post.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable forecasts predominantly move from 2025–2026 in 2023 to 2026–2027 by the post date, without clear acknowledgment of the revision.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable forecasts retain the original timetable, or the apparent date change concerns a materially different capability threshold rather than postponement of the original forecast.
